evidence.extractedText: Endorsement of Nursing Licenses - RPN | Office of the Professions Skip to main content The New York State Education Department (“SED”) Office of the Professions (“OP”) is alerting everyone to a vishing scam that has been brought to our attention. Phishing—or “vishing”—scams impersonate SED employees or websites attempting to collect licensure and personal information from the licensee.
